quote: we introduce Negative Implicit Feedback from Smart Reply ("NIFTY"). NIFTY employs classifier guidance to controllably integrate one-shot implicit negative feedback into the generation process at run-time.

We evaluate using standard AI writing metrics, rather than success‑based task‑oriented metrics ... Our approach, NIFTY, uses implicit negative feedback from the rejected suggestions to improve the AI writer's prediction.
We treat replies containing multiple intents as unique intents in their own right as it is unclear that a user would accept a suggestion that only partially contained the desired intents.

We employ both automatic and human evaluation.
